nonaccrual_reconstruction_from_soi.method: Independent re-tally of every SOI row carrying footnote (C) 'Non-accruing debt investment'.
nonaccrual_reconstruction_from_soi.reconciliation_gap: My footnote-(C) tally finds 12 issuers / 6.95% of cost vs the filing's stated 13 companies / 7.4%. The filing's sentence covers 'debt AND preferred equity' investments; footnote (C) is defined only as 'Non-accruing debt investment', so at least one preferred-equity non-accrual is not code-C tagged. Treat the filing's 13 / 7.4% / 1.6% as authority.
nonaccrual_reconstruction_from_soi.observation: The 5.8-point gap between cost (7.4%) and fair value (1.6%) means the non-accrual book is already written to ~19c. GoTab, Inc. (Fishbowl) is the one outlier: on non-accrual yet marked at 100.6% of cost.

top20_method: Every row of the June 30, 2026 Consolidated Schedule of Investments parsed positionally (12/11/9/8/7-column row shapes), aggregated by issuer, ranked by fair value. Extracted totals tie EXACTLY to the balance sheet: cost $1,436,179,888 and fair value $1,290,523,348. 'par' sums principal on debt instruments only, so fv_pct_of_par is meaningless where an issuer's exposure is mostly equity (e.g. 36th Street) — use fv_pct_of_cost there. Industry is the SOI section heading; two entries picked up a stray header ('Total Coupon') and are unreliable for SEP Eiger BidCo and Honey Intermediate.

unfunded_commitments.source: Note 5 Commitments and Contingencies, 'Total Unfunded Balances'

asset_coverage.source: 'As of June 30, 2026, the Company's asset coverage ratio was 160.3%.' (Note on Borrowings / regulatory section)
asset_coverage.cushion_analysis: SignalOS recomputation from the filed balance sheet: gross debt $916,990,693 (net $910,581,937 plus $6,408,756 of deferred issuance costs); non-debt liabilities $13,874,763; total assets $1,476,463,527. That yields 159.5% against the filing's stated 160.3% (small difference in issuance-cost treatment), which validates the method. Holding debt constant, total assets can fall to $1,389,360,802 before the 150% floor binds - headroom of $87,102,724, equal to a 6.75% markdown of the $1,290,523,348 portfolio, at which point net assets would be about $464.9mm ($5.54/share). This is the tightest structural constraint in the file and is computed, not filed.
asset_coverage.election: Shareholders approved the 150% (rather than 200%) asset coverage election effective 2019-02-09.

structural_notes.leverage_events: Six months 2026: repaid $547.9M of credit facility draws, drew $342.7M, issued $405.4M of secured notes, repaid $325.0M of unsecured notes, and on 2026-06-17 paid off all outstanding SBA Debentures. Debt net of issuance costs fell from $1,035.5M to $910.6M.

incentive_fee_mechanics.structure: 17.5% of ordinary income and of net realized gains (net of unrealized depreciation), subject to a cumulative total-return hurdle of 7% per annum on daily weighted-average contributed common equity, computed cumulatively since January 1, 2013 and payable quarterly in arrears.
incentive_fee_mechanics.current_status: 'As of June 30, 2026, the Company's cumulative total return did not exceed the total return hurdle and, as a result, no incentive compensation was accrued for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026.'
incentive_fee_mechanics.pik_conflict_assessment: The standard BDC conflict — incentive fee struck on NII, which PIK inflates — is currently INOPERATIVE at TCPC: no incentive fee is being earned at all. However the cumulative total-return hurdle creates a DIFFERENT and arguably stronger mark-integrity conflict: total return includes unrealized appreciation, so higher marks move the adviser back toward a hurdle it is currently failing. Directionally this rewards mark support, not PIK.
incentive_fee_mechanics.merger_carve_out: Amounts arising from ASC 805 purchase-accounting adjustments to the cost basis of BCIC assets acquired in the merger are EXCLUDED from adjusted NII for incentive-fee purposes.

structural_notes.base_management_fee: 1.25% annually on total assets (excluding cash) up to 200% of NAV, 1.00% above; reduced from 1.50% at the merger closing. Advisor waived one-third of the fee for each quarter of 2025 ($7.3M waived for FY2025). No waiver disclosed for 2026 — management fees payable rose from $3,393,322 to $4,124,508 while total investment income fell 22% YoY.
structural_notes.blackrock_adviser_arrangement: Adviser is BlackRock TCP Capital Advisors. Amended and Restated Investment Advisory Agreement effective at the BCIC merger closing cut the base fee to 1.25%/1.00%. The 2019 shareholder-approved amendment cut incentive compensation from 20% to 17.5% and the cumulative total-return hurdle from 8% to 7%. A Fee Waiver Agreement guaranteeing adjusted NII of at least $0.32/share applied only to the four quarters following closing and EXPIRED after 2025-12-31 — TCPC has run below that $0.32 threshold in each of the last three quarters (0.26, 0.22, 0.22) with no waiver protection.
structural_notes.expense_ratios: Annualized ratio to average net assets, six months 2026: net investment income 12.7%, total expenses 15.9% (vs 13.1% expenses / 15.4% NII a year earlier). Expense ratio rising against a shrinking equity base.

controlled_affiliate_concentration.soi_note_codes: E (restricted security) / F (controlled issuer, 25%+ of voting securities) / N
controlled_affiliate_concentration.prior_period: At 2025-12-31 the units were cost $33,992,650 / fair value $51,042,935. During six months 2026 TCPC funded $4,000,001 of additional cost; the Schedule of Changes in Investments in Affiliates shows only $34,732 + $20,000 of change attributable to appreciation, so the 45% premium is a legacy mark carried forward, not a fresh 2026 write-up.
controlled_affiliate_concentration.income_contribution: Six months 2026: $3,585,386 of interest on the Senior Note plus $2,614,290 of dividend income on the Membership Units = $6,199,676, or 7.5% of total investment income, from a controlled, self-marked affiliate.
controlled_affiliate_concentration.why_it_matters: This is the single largest mark-integrity exposure in the file: TCPC's biggest position, a controlled issuer with no third-party price, carried 45% above cost and equal to 20.8% of net assets, while the rest of the book is marked at 90c on cost.

market_price_vs_nav.live_check: IBKR live quote 2026-08-17: last $4.05, bid 4.05 / ask 4.06, prior close $4.08. Against the 6/30/26 NAV of $6.58 that is a 38.4% discount — the desk's 38% premise is TAPE-VERIFIED. Note the discount NARROWED from 48.9% at quarter-end to 38.4% today.

structural_notes.portfolio_yield: Weighted average effective yield on the debt portfolio at fair value 11.2% (6/30/26) vs 11.1% (12/31/25), excluding non-accrual and non-income-producing loans; total portfolio 10.5% vs 10.2%. 93.9% of debt investments floating rate.
structural_notes.cash_position: Cash and cash equivalents $157,546,660 = 28.5% of net assets, 10.88% of total cash and investments — an unusually large cash balance relative to NAV.

coverage_gaps: No internal risk-rating / performance-rating migration table is disclosed anywhere in the 10-Q. Cannot be extracted from primary source because it does not exist in the filing.

PIK income is disclosed ONLY as a six-month cash-flow reconciling item. Quarterly PIK ($3,028,644 for Q2-2026 and $5,843,626 for Q2-2025) is DERIVED by differencing against the Q1 10-Q, not a filed number. PIK is never expressed as a percentage of investment income by the company.

PIK is not split between interest and dividends, and not attributed to individual borrowers. The SOI does show per-instrument coupon splits such as '2.75% Cash + 2.75% PIK', so borrower-level PIK could be reconstructed from coupon text but was not in this pass.
The per-share NAV bridge is presented six-month only; the realized-vs-unrealized split is dollar-only (Statements of Operations), not per-share.

Non-accrual footnote (C) covers debt only; the filing's 13-company count includes preferred equity, so a full position-level non-accrual list at the filing's own definition cannot be assembled from the SOI codes alone.
Return-of-capital characterization of 2026 distributions is not disclosed in the interim filing (tax character is determined annually).
Industry labels for SEP Eiger BidCo Ltd. (Beqom) and Honey Intermediate, Inc. (iLobby) picked up a stray table header during parsing and should be re-read from the SOI before use.
No prior-year (Q2-2025) 10-Q was separately downloaded; prior-year comparatives were taken from the comparative columns inside the Q2-2026 filing plus XBRL companyfacts for the intervening quarters.
